tools.name: DaVinci Resolve MCP Bridge (hiteshK03)
tools.tagline: Resolve 18+ free or Studio via in-app bridge; stdio; MIT
tools.claudeConnection: Local stdio, bridge script inside Resolve
tools.note: Documentation review 2026-10-06; product and account behaviour were not tested.

quickstart.label: Server setup copied from the README (step 2). Copy src/CursorBridge.py into Resolve's scripts folder first:
quickstart.code:
git clone https://github.com/hiteshK03/davinci-resolve-mcp.git
cd davinci-resolve-mcp
python -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate   # Windows: venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
